other_conditions: Legal nominee or dependent of the deceased worker must apply
Deceased worker must have been engaged in building or other construction work
Deceased worker must have been registered with the Meghalaya Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Death may be natural or accidental during the course of employment
benefits_summary: ₹2,00,000 is paid for natural death and ₹3,00,000 for accidental death (₹5,00,000 if the worker was not covered by any insurance) to the nominee or dependent of the registered construction worker.
